horoscopes.horoscope: Today you will feel like going green, and Ganesha approves. You could plant a sapling, or organise some dustbins to keep the neighbourhood clean. If you wish to make the world a better place to live in, do it but take it step by step. Love life may be on the beam with your friendly approach. You will get along with your mate very easily. Your adventurous spirit will influence your partner a lot, feels Ganesha. This will enhance an amazing partnership with your beloved, says Ganesha. Apart from work, Ganesha suggests you to enroll in some physical activities as today, you are likely to feel angry and stressed at the workplace. Much work may affect your health. Besides, it is better to be polite with everyone around you. Ganesha feels that today you will be very happy to see the increase in the cash flow. Your financial struggle as if has become past. You will be glad to see this happy state of the matter. Ganesha is excited to tell you that you will get the rewards of your efforts. Plus, may be able to implement new technology at the workplace and may try to use programs and software codes never used before. You will get appreciation from your senior authorities.

Much to the disappointment and annoyance of your friends and associates, you are likely to act unduly possessive and self centred about persons and objects, warns Ganesha. Be sure, your overprotective attitude is not likely to amuse anyone. To make matters worse you will possibly ignore their well founded resentment and instead of setting matters right, you will be running after material gains. Try to reconsider your actions and motives. No one is likely to forget and forgive anything. Your profession will keep you occupied most of the day, you might have to put in extra effort to please your spouse. You may have to simplify some issues to have a harmonious relationship. Spending wonderful times outside will make you feel at home. Ganesha predicts that decision making may get difficult. As a result you might feel low and over stressed today. There are chances of conflict with a family member. Hence it is advisable to have patience and wait for a better day. It’s all about your career progress today, which is directly linked with your finances. You will not be depending on other people’s money. Instead, you will be depending on your own efforts. Your involvement in developmental activities at the workplace will be appreciated. You might have to check deadlines as some administrative work too will keep you occupied. You may come to the conclusion too easily. Ganesha says you should think pros and cons before making an important decision.

You will ponder over religious and cultural values and issues today. You will indulge in a fair amount of discussion with your family members over the issue and present your thoughts and feelings on the subject. These discussions could end up covering topics like law, education, societal concerns, manners and etiquette etc., says Ganesha. It’s going to be a memorable evening with your beloved. The fun-filled activities will make you feel happy. You are feeling confident to move with the pace of the daily lifestyle. Overall, love life is going to be full of excitement. Ganesha says that your skills will be highly praised today. However, there are chances of a few conflicts, hence its advisable to remain calm now. Besides, you’ll feel energetic throughout the day. You’re likely to get health conscious now and enroll yourself with some physical activities. Your happiness index is closely linked with your financial index, so that if one goes up the other one too goes up, and when one goes down the other one also goes down. Pay equal attention to both. The day will keep you very busy professionally. Meetings and interactions every now and then will keep you moving from one place to another. As you have so many things to do during the day, you will prefer being straightforward and to the point.

The day looks set to be an ordinary day, for both work and play, says Ganesha. Yet, if you are planning to participate in an event or a competition today, march ahead, by all means. There will, practically, be no one who’ll be able to compete with you. On other fronts, expect things to be rather calm and mundane, with no significant ups and downs. You are in a mood to get appreciation from your partner, foresees Ganesha. Even a brief conversation with your partner will satiate you. Managing emotional stability with your partner will not be so difficult once you will get emotional support, says Ganesha. Ganesha predicts that you may feel dim and tired today. Achieving targets may get difficult. There are a few possibilities of an argument with a close friend. Hence it is advisable to be polite and wait for a better day. Ganesha says that if there are loopholes in your financial strategy, they can be plugged by saving more money. You need to look for solutions to your financial problems instead of simply feeling low. It is possible that someone else handles your responsibility today, but there is no need to feel insecure. You may even try to complete the routine work in a hurry in order to prove yourself. You should take your own time and do the work with precision and not mind even if you have to stay back late.

A moment once lost is not going to come back. So, it’s about time you realised the value of time, says Ganesha, because time is money. On this day, set everything to a schedule and figure out your tasks right down to the brass tacks. Personal organisers are a good bet, but if you are old school, then maybe you would rather prefer a diary and a calendar. Either of the options work just fine, suggests Ganesha. Try to keep your head as cool as possible when you are with your sweetheart, says Ganesha. You will be able to keep your love life as smooth as possible. Things will remain peaceful if you understand your beloved and act accordingly. Ganesha says that you may be engaged in work throughout the day and that might make you a bit temperamental today. You’ll demand for finishing the pending work, hence you may over stress yourself. Try be polite at work as only then you can stay happy. Today you might come across a proposal to start a partnership business, but Ganesha feels you may not be too keen on it. You need to relax and spend quality time with your family members. You need to do an in-depth analysis of a professional issue. This is a day to put yourself in others’ shoes to understand their needs and problems. Lack of support from your colleagues may annoy you but the scenario will soon change. It’s better to keep worries aside.

Your communication and creative abilities are your best weapons. You will be overflowing with zest for life and will exude cheerfulness. However, Ganesha warns that your creativity will bloom fully only in situations where there is no pressure or strain. Your love life will remain almost uneventful, says Ganesha. You may like to show commitment but you will remain so absorbed in work that you may not find quality time for your loved one. However, it will not have a major effect on the relationship. Ganesha foresees that today you will have to be a bit careful about your health. It’s not a completely negative day but not even very positive day for health. You should try to avoid overloading your brain or body, says Ganesha. Routine expenses are foreseen today. If you seriously count, you will realise that you are spending a lot per month, per quarter, per half year and per year. This needs to be worked upon. Though you prefer working silently and discreetly, your work will not go unnoticed today. You tend to bring some strict approaches for a particular project. Pay attention to your colleagues attitude. You may share your experiences at work that may benefit your subordinates.

Ganesha says you will try to gain in-depth knowledge about new technological inventions in your spare time today. Some of you may have queries regarding higher education that you may be able to take up today and reach a conclusion about. It’s a party time. You are in a mood to manage a private event at your home or garden lounge. You may plan to go out for an entertainment programme with your beloved. A get-together with old time friends will refresh you completely. Health wise, Ganesha does not foresee any problem. Ganesha feels that today you will be investing energy in proving your abilities. You will be coming across good opportunities to learn things. That will help you a great deal. It’s a good day for you. Ganesha finds the day to be in your favour for money matters. Till date, whatever you have invested will look good to you. It’s not necessary to do away with anything to meet your current financial requirements. Today you want to do anything for your progress at the workplace. You will have every opportunity to polish your work skills in order to prove your abilities and you will succeed in impressing your boss. Ganesha says it will be safe if you keep the matter strictly professional.

Till now you have experienced all the highs. Today you may come across the lows of the professional world. The equation between your boss, colleagues and you may get slightly disturbed. However, you will make it up by evening. Freshers may look for some career opportunities. The boring day will be gone when your sweetheart will present some mouth-watering foods in the company of those close to you. Give your mind and body the rest it requires. You are likely to get the emotional support from your partner. Ganesha feels that today your energy level won’t be very high. You will be thinking a lot about various aspects of life. However, your low energy will not allow you to do much. It’s better to note down ideas and implement them some other day. It is going to be a hectic day filled with lots of activities concerning home and work both. You will hardly have time to think seriously about money matters. It is alright if you don’t pay attention to money matters today. Low energy levels will keep you out of focus at the workplace. Ideas will come to your mind, but the low energy levels will hardly let you implement them. This is a time to focus more on planning. You should get your team ready to delegate the work.

Being a part of all things bright and beautiful will remain the highpoint today, says Ganesha. You may don the hat of an activist and fight injustice and discrimination in the right spirits. Even if you are asked to conquer the world, you will be able to do it today, says Ganesha. Your wish to have intellectual discussions with your life partner feels Ganesha. You may come up with some brilliant ideas about romance. However, your partner may be ready to play some sweet games with you and you are ready to explore the beauty. From health point of view, it is going to be a good day. Ganesha feels that while you will be dealing with various activities at work today, you may have to remain focussed on your targets. Besides, you will find easy ways to do things. Ganesha feels that you will have travel scheduled on your plan today. There will be money invested in the same but it will surely be beneficial for you. You will be bit stressed out due to brainstorming sessions. You may find yourself exploring new paths, foresees Ganesha. You are ready to learn at the workplace. Ganesha says you will get all the professional supports. You may decide to gather as much knowledge as possible about the work you are presently handling.

Today, you will not be in the right mood to work or produce expected results. Mounting work pressure may further dampen your self-confidence, foretells Ganesha. The dullness will vanish in the air by the evening and you will be back to your happy self. Are you wondering who will be responsible for this change? The answer is your friends and family members. Quality time spent with family members will make you forget the stress. You are more open and flexible with your better half and ready to listen to his/her suggestions. You may welcome a positive change in you or the surroundings at the home. Ganesha feels that it’s a day full of energy and busy schedule. You will be handling your responsibilities very well today. There will be strong need to communicate what you feel. While you do the same, you may also appear to be bitter to others. Any financial transaction done today will be attracting more money. You will be able to have substantial financial returns of your investments. Think seriously and positively about increasing your income. You may be busy planning meetings and scheduling work for the week. The busy day involves a lot of research for that major responsibility you have been given. You need to communicate well with others. You will remain satisfied the way things are going in the evening.

You spend a lot of time planning for a better future. Sure, it does minimize the chances of errors as you know possible obstacles in advance. But, the time you spend for calculations takes you away from the reality and you don’t fully concentrate on what you have now. Learn to balance, advises Ganesha. You will be in a rollicking mood throughout the day and so love life may be mesmerizing. Your beauty will attract your sweetheart and he/she is likely to fall in love. You may play a sweet game that will be appreciated by your beau. The day is going to be good for your health, says Ganesha. You will stay positive about everything. You will be able to take a plunge into something new. Positive thinking will be making you feel much much better today. You will realise the importance of financial planning. You will give due weight to every aspect related to money. The more you do an accountant kind of job mentally, the better your financial progress would be. This is a good time to start new projects, foretells Ganesha. Your talent and skills will help you successfully handle the managerial tasks. You will remain logical and interpersonal communication will be brilliant for the day. Decision-making will be easy for you.

You know how important money is and you will think about it all day. You will think less about expenses today and more about prosperity and fame today. Worry about family might increase and in return they will support you, says Ganesha. You may not wish to share your feelings with your beloved, but speaking out all the fears and frustrations will make you feel much better. Your emotion will be under control when you feel free with your beloved. It’s safer to be with your sweetheart rather than being alone. Ganesha feels that today you will need some time alone. You should avoid negative thinking. Try to meditate, that will help you a great deal. You are not in a position to handle pressure so avoid stressful tasks, advises Ganesha. Bad luck is different than having no luck in any matter. Today, you will be experiencing bad luck. This means that there is scope of improvement in the future. Although stars are not in favour, you will not be broke. Handling the daily boring works may seem a little difficult due to the confusions in mind. If you want to stay away from depression, it is high time you learn to handle pressure, says Ganesha. For this, you need to be practical and have to discuss with your peers.
